Congratulations on completing this journey! You've connected Grafana Cloud to ClickHouse from start to finish.

Along the way, you:

- Learned why ClickHouse pairs well with Grafana for logs, traces, and analytics
- Created a read-only ClickHouse user that can still enforce query timeouts
- Added the ClickHouse data source in Grafana Cloud
- Configured the server address, protocol, port, and credentials
- Saved and tested the connection, and learned to read the error categories
- Verified your data by running a query in Explore

---

### Related paths

Consider taking the following paths after you complete this journey:

- [Explore logs with Logs Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-logs/)
- [Explore traces with Traces Drilldown](https://grafana.com/docs/learning-paths/drilldown-traces/)
